additional_info.subject: ID0377054-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000447] XF4 Connectivity issue CRM:00797001220
additional_info.body:
Hi Itai! Good morning, how are you doing? Did you enjoy your weekend?
I have accessed the Router 2 and found that the SIM card is not inserted
And as such there is no connection.
For me there can only be either:
SIM card not inserted properly as the “error” says
SIM card is damaged
SIM card tray is damaged
Gap between the SIM card and the router.
I don't usually recommend this and it's completely up to you, but if you find that the issue is related to the gap between them, you can try using a little piece of paper to lessen the gap.
In sum, there is nothing I can do remotely at the moment.
Thank you and have a nice start of the week!
Best regards,
Francisco
